title: Winter Protection Plan Review Window — Truth Table
content:
# Winter Protection Plan Review Window — Truth Table

**Rule.** When a defaulted Winter Protection Plan of the Payment Arrangement program is reinstated, the winter review window — the period over which the Electric Service Agreement's returned-payment charges are reviewed — is:

| Start date of the Electric Service Agreement at least 60 whole calendar months before the request | Returned-payment charge posted to it within the 24 months before the request | Winter review window |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | The 6 months before the request |
| Yes | Yes | The 9 months before the request |
| No | No | The 12 months before the request |
| No | Yes | The 12 months before the request |

Months between the start date and the request are counted in whole calendar months. A window of a number of months before the request covers entries dated after the same calendar day that many months earlier, up to and including the request date.

## Boundary readings (hypothetical agreement started November 18, 2020)

| Request dated | Whole calendar months since the start date | At least 60 |
|---|---|---|
| November 17, 2025 | 59 | No — window of 12 months |
| November 18, 2025 | 60 | Yes |
